column1: # The differences acceptance check 2ma lets the observation modes keep, one per line, read by
# spike/mode-agreement.py. Columns (tab-separated): base mode, other mode, CPU (any, x86_64 or
# aarch64), toy, side (base or mode: which mode records the line), the normalized record, why.
# A row allows one occurrence; a row that does not occur on a pair and CPU the run compared
# fails the check as stale. Not compared at all: close, the thread-order records (started, join,
# detach), the markers (shim_ready, kill_landed, cgroup), and an exec's image path. A toy every
# mode refuses is compared by its refusal's reason alone.

column7: posix_spawn execs its child inside libc, where the shim has no wrapper; the supervisor sees the execve itself
